violated_contract: An explicit question about the user's screen must be answered from pixels of the subject the user means. When the asking surface is itself on screen — the main chat window is frontmost by construction of a typed send — a capture taken at answer time photographs the asker, so the evidence must instead come from the most recent stored frame of a non-asker app, or the turn must answer that no honest evidence exists.
canonical_prevention: Route explicit screen questions through a decision layer keyed on the asking surface: self-referential surfaces answer from the newest stored frame of a non-asker app with the frame's app, window, and age named as provenance; every other surface keeps a turn-scoped live capture; and the no-frame case ships an honest failure payload that tells the user to switch apps instead of shipping the asker's own window with a disclaimer.
